October 28 • 1 minute to build your Birthday Bank!

HOW TO PLAY

When the dice are rolling, press Space to select a board. Click neighboring letters to build a word of 3 or more letters, then click SUBMIT WORD or press Space. Letters must connect horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, and a square cannot be reused in the same word. Qu is one square. Each accepted word counts once per game.

Earn $0.25 per valid word, plus $0.25 for each green die and $0.50 for each orange die in that word. The Birthday Bank has a $0.75 maximum.

The 1-minute timer begins with your first letter click. On later boards, some dice change letters every 10 seconds. Green dice stay fixed while selected. Orange dice change even while selected and clear your current word if they change while selected.

Trial winnings are pretend. Real Money mode requires Jacob’s password and is available only once. Starting Real Money mode uses up the one allowed play, even if you close the browser.
